user.title: Elpriser
user.description: Electricity prices from elpriser.org - a free service, no account or key needed. Pick the price zone you want. Denmark has two zones and asks for the price type next; every other zone shows the wholesale (day-ahead) price without VAT, taxes and grid fees.

data_description.zone: One entry per zone. You can add more zones later.

denmark.title: Denmark {area}
denmark.description: Choose which price to follow. The default is everything except your own grid company's tariff. Choose a grid company (and a price type that includes the grid tariff) to get the price you actually pay.

data_description.mode: Prices are in DKK/kWh. The net_* types add your grid company's tariff and need a grid company.
data_description.gln: Pick your grid company, or type its 13-digit GLN number if it is not listed.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach elpriser.org. Check the internet connection and try again.
error.no_data: elpriser.org has no prices for this choice (yet).
error.gln_required: This price type needs a grid company.
error.gln_needs_net_mode: A grid company only applies to the net_* price types.

abort.already_configured: This zone, price type and grid company is already set up.

init.title: Elpriser options
init.description: These only change what is shown; they do not cause extra requests.

data_description.cheap_hours: The 'Cheap hour now' sensor is on during this many cheapest hours of the day.
data_description.show_forecast: Add the 'forecast' attribute (up to 10 days ahead; elpriser.org's own model, not official) to the 'Price now' sensor.

options.inkl_alt: All-in without grid tariff (spot + Energinet tariffs + electricity tax + VAT)
options.inkl_alt_minus: All-in without grid tariff and without electricity tax
options.inkl_alt_elvarme: All-in without grid tariff, reduced tax (electric heating)
options.net_inkl_alt: Full price incl. grid tariff (needs a grid company)
options.net_inkl_alt_elvarme: Full price incl. grid tariff, reduced tax (electric heating)
options.net_inkl_tarif: Incl. grid tariff, without electricity tax
